subject: SOC2 evidence and IR log retention clarification
messages:
From: Sally Jensen <sally.jensen@quantahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@quantahealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 evidence & IR log retention clarification

Hi Ben,

Following up on our vendor SOC 2 review: our compliance team is asking for a few items related to incident response and telemetry retention before the Thursday audit window. Specifically: 

- Your IR playbook or summary (high level) showing notifications and escalation timelines.
- Retention windows for auth/access logs and API request logs. We need to confirm the default retention and any available longer-term archives.
- A small, sanitized sample of access logs demonstrating the fields you provide (timestamps, user id, client IP, request id). We only need a 24–48 hour slice; please redact any PII.

Can you confirm what you can share and whether you need an NDA/DPA addendum to transfer sanitized logs? Also please indicate a target date — our audit lead would like these by Wed EOD PT if feasible.

Thanks,
Sally Jensen
Security Operations Manager
QuantaHealth

---
Note: contact for procurement: security@quantahealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sally Jensen <sally.jensen@quantahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence & IR log retention clarification

Sally — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide everything you listed. Quick summary and next steps below: 

1) IR playbook: I attached a 2-page IR summary that covers notification windows, RACI, and escalation to leadership. It is redacted for customer-facing details but suitable for SOC2 review. (attachment: redwood_irp_summary_202703.pdf)

2) Retention windows: by default, auth and API request logs are retained 90 days hot. We have tiered cold archives for up to 2 years on request (billing/contract permitting). Marissa can provide the S3 manifest path and a sanitized sample extraction.

3) Sample logs: we can produce a 48-hour sanitized CSV with request id, timestamp (UTC), action, user_handle (hashed), client_ip (anonymized to /24), and status code. We will not include full request bodies. If you require additional fields, please list them.

On the DPA/NDA: transfers of customer-identifiable material require our data-sharing addendum. For sanitized telemetry that contains no customer identifiers we can share under our standard SOC2 evidence transfer; if you need explicit legal protection we can route a short DocuSign addendum (I can send today).

Timeline: Marissa and Karthik — can you confirm feasibility to produce the sanitized sample and S3 manifest by Wed 17:00 PT? We'll also include a short MAP and delivery link.

Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sally Jensen <sally.jensen@quantahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 12:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: SOC2 evidence & IR log retention clarification

Hi team,

Confirming we can deliver the requested artifacts. Details: 

- Log locations: auth logs and API request logs are exported to s3://redwood-compliance/us-prod-logs/{year}/{month}/. We will provide a manifest slice for 2027-02-27 to 2027-02-28. (attachment: s3_log_manifest_202702.csv)

- Sanitization: we will hash user handles with a per-request salt, truncate client IPs to /24, and remove any request payload. Column set: timestamp_utc, request_id, event_type, user_hash, client_ip_trunc, response_code.

- Retention: 90 days hot by default. Cold archive available up to 2 years via an admin request; retrieval time from archive is 4–8 hours. Extended retention requires a signed contract amendment or schedule in the existing enterprise commitment.

- Delivery: we will upload a sanitized CSV to a shared Drive folder and place copies in a pre-authorized S3 bucket (read-only, expiring credentials). For legal transfer, Ben can start a DocuSign envelope for a short evidence transfer acknowledgment if Quanta prefers.

I'll prepare the sanitized sample (48h) now and aim to upload by Wed 17:00 PT. Attaching the manifest for the slice I will extract.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Sally Jensen <sally.jensen@quantahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 07:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence & IR log retention clarification

Thank you — that plan looks good. A couple quick clarifications from the audit team before we proceed: 

- Please ensure the timestamps are in UTC and include timezone info (we need to confirm correlation across systems).
- For the client_ip_trunc, replacing the final octet with 0 is fine.
- For the manifest: can you include MD5 checksums for the files you upload so our ingestion script can validate integrity?

One more ask: could you provide a 1-paragraph summary of the IR playbook that we can include in our report? We only need the summary (not the full playbook).

If you can deliver the sanitized CSV and the one-paragraph IR summary by Wed 17:00 PT, we'll mark this item resolved. On the DPA: we can accept the sanitized transfer under standard evidence rules; we don't need DocuSign for this slice.

Best,
Sally
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sally Jensen <sally.jensen@quantahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence & IR log retention clarification

Sally — great, thanks for confirming. Summary and delivery plan: 

- Marissa will upload the sanitized CSV (UTC timestamps, client_ip with final octet zeroed) and the manifest including MD5 checksums to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example/IRP-evidence by Wed 2027-03-17 17:00 PT.

- Karthik will attach a one-paragraph IR playbook blurb for audit use and include it in the shared folder.

- I'll add a short mutual action plan (attachment: mutual_action_plan_quanta-due20270321.pdf) with owners and due dates for follow-ups related to any extended retention requests. If you later need logs beyond 90 days we can initiate an archive retrieval request (4–8 hour SLA).

If anything changes we'll flag it in the folder and email the audit lead. Thanks for the quick turnaround — we'll be in touch when uploads are complete.

Ben

-- 
Attachments referenced: redwood_irp_summary_202703.pdf (pdf), s3_log_manifest_202702.csv (csv), sanitized_access_sample_20270228.csv (csv), mutual_action_plan_quanta-due20270321.pdf (pdf)
